title: We Built a Hood Movie Bracket… And This Won | Carmelo Anthony, Mero & Kaz
text: We Built a Hood Movie Bracket… And This Won | Carmelo Anthony, Mero & KazThe crew turned March Madness into something else. Melo, Mero, and Kaz argue their way through a hood movie bracket that includes classics like Paid in Full, Friday, Menace II Society, New Jack City, Belly, and more to crown the greatest hood film of all time. It gets real very quickly. Storytelling vs quotables. East Coast vs West Coast. What actually makes a movie timeless. Some picks feel easy. Others turn into real debates. And by the end… a winner gets crowned. Tap in. #Friday #PaidInFull #CarmeloAnthony #BlackCinema #7PMInBrooklyn . . . New episodes drop every Monday. Subscribe to the podcast on Spotify, Apple, or wherever you get your podcasts, and follow the show on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok for all the best moments from the show.
